ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the attached figure, on the right side there is a square, and beside the right side of the square there is a vertical label "4 cm", indicating that the side length of the square is 4 cm. On the left side there is a triangle attached to the left side of the square; the triangle and the square share the left vertical side of the square. The entire outer outline is composed of the top, right, and bottom three sides of the square and the two slanted sides of the triangle, forming a pentagon. Reasoning: The side length of the square is 4 cm, so the perimeter of the square is 4 × 4 = 16 cm. The problem says that the triangle and the square have the same perimeter, so the perimeter of the triangle is also 16 cm. The side shared by the triangle and the square is one side of the square, with length 4 cm; this side is inside the whole figure and is not counted in the outer perimeter. The total length of the two sides of the triangle exposed on the outside is 16 − 4 = 12 cm. The total length of the three sides of the square exposed on the outside is 3 × 4 = 12 cm. Therefore the perimeter of the whole pentagon is 12 + 12 = 24 cm.

raw_record.question_text: The triangle and the square have the same perimeter. What is the perimeter of the whole figure (a pentagon)?

method.method_draft: Read the diagram as a square on the right with side length 4 cm, and a triangle attached to the square along the square's left vertical side. The outside boundary of the combined pentagon consists of the top, right, and bottom sides of the square plus the two slanted outer sides of the triangle; the shared vertical side is internal and not counted. From the text, use that the triangle and square have equal perimeters. The square perimeter is 4×4=16 cm, so the triangle perimeter is also 16 cm. Since the triangle's shared side is the square side of length 4 cm, the two exposed triangle sides total 16−4=12 cm. Add the three exposed square sides, 3×4=12 cm, to get the whole pentagon perimeter 12+12=24 cm.
